description: Phase 1 - Fresh, assumption-free re-audit of the full documentation corpus against code reality. Treat every doc claim as unverified. For each docs cluster (Product/Architecture/ADRs; Domain contracts: DATA-MODEL, STATE-MACHINES, SCHEMAS, TASK-RUNTIME, TRUST, ENVIRONMENTS, DELEGATION, LEARNING; UI/Flows/Ledgers; Capability/LiteSPM/Connectors; Automation/Runtime/Mesh) produce a verified 'doc claim -> code reality -> verdict (true / stale / aspirational-unlabeled / contradicted)' table, file every newly-discovered contradiction into docs/CONTRADICTION-AND-ALIGNMENT-REGISTER.md with correctly-allocated A-xx (from A-51) / B-xx (from B-34) IDs resolved AT the owning doc, reconcile the known drift, and surface SDD-completeness gaps. Depends on FEAT-001 (branch + baseline numbers). Independent of FEAT-003 (competitor research) except that FEAT-004 consumes both.
steps: Work on branch docs/audit-competitor-superset. Re-read the authority chain first (ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/README.md, docs/SPECIFICATION-STANDARD.md, docs/IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md which is the source-backed status authority, and the full docs/CONTRADICTION-AND-ALIGNMENT-REGISTER.md A-01..A-50 / B-11..B-33) so you resolve each contradiction AT its owner and never create a competing authority.

Cluster-by-cluster, read each owner doc and spot-check its concrete claims against the actual source (READ-ONLY; code is not changed this round) and against IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md. Clusters: (a) Product/Architecture/ADRs: PRODUCT.md, V1-PRODUCT-RELEASE-CONTRACT.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/adr/*; (b) Domain contracts: DATA-MODEL.md, STATE-MACHINES.md, SCHEMAS.md + docs/schemas/*, TASK-RUNTIME/ENVIRONMENTS.md/TRUST.md/DELEGATION.md/LEARNING.md; (c) UI/Flows/Ledgers: FLOWS.md, V1-UI-SCREEN-CONTRACT.md, V1-UI-ACTION-STATE-LEDGER.md, SEMANTIC-SERVED-UI-MAP.md, COVERAGE-MATRIX.md, FEATURE-AND-UI-CONTRACT-COVERAGE.md; (d) Capability/LiteSPM/Connectors: CAPABILITY-FABRIC.md, CAPABILITY-INVOCATIONS.md, LITESPM-*.md, CONNECTORS-WORKFLOWS.md, CONNECTOR-FACTORY-DESIGN.md; (e) Automation/Runtime/Mesh: AUTOMATION.md, ROUTINES.md, RESPONSIBILITIES.md, RUNTIME-LIFECYCLE.md, LOCAL-OPERATOR-IPC.md, AGENT-FABRIC.md, EVENTS.md. Use the known ground-truth from IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md and the existing A-01..A-50 rows as the yardstick: exactly one real agent path (OpenCode v2.0.32, fire-and-forget, ineffective Stop, backend-only Retry); no real Task execution pipeline; Terminal fabricates exit 0; Browser is a disclaimed iframe; diffs synthetic; Trust/Environments/computer-use/Artifacts/Coworker-memory TARGET-only.

Create ONE new doc docs/DOCS-REAUDIT-2026.md (there is no existing owner for a full assumption-free re-audit verdict table; REPOSITORY-DOCUMENTATION-AUDIT.md tracks consistency/validation status, link to it and to IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md, do not duplicate them) containing a table with columns: Doc + section | Claim (quoted/paraphrased) | Code reality (with file path evidence) | Verdict {true | stale | aspirational-unlabeled | contradicted} | Register ID (A-xx) if newly filed. Organize by the five clusters. Follow the repo voice and evidence vocabulary (TARGET/CODE/SERVED/INTEGRATED/QUALIFIED). Add docs/DOCS-REAUDIT-2026.md to docs/README.md's index section.

For every claim verdicted stale/aspirational-unlabeled/contradicted that is not already covered by an existing A-xx row, file a new row in docs/CONTRADICTION-AND-ALIGNMENT-REGISTER.md allocating sequential IDs from A-51 upward (table columns: ID | Area | Current authoritative statement | Consequence), and apply the actual correction AT the owning doc in the same change (the register links to the owner; it does not redefine). If a claim needs an owner decision/blocking question not yet tracked, allocate the next blocking ID from B-34 upward per SPECIFICATION-STANDARD.md section 5 and reference it consistently across owner SPEC/register.

Reconcile the known drift/danglers explicitly: (A-38) fix FLOWS.md's 'Flow outputs and UI projection' index to include F115-F124 and F136-F143 and resolve the F128/F119 duplicate; (A-39) resolve the UIV1-001..158 namespace - either re-anchor the citing docs (FLOWS.md, COVERAGE-MATRIX.md, COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md, TESTING.md) onto live flow IDs or restore the registry into the active corpus, and record the decision in the register; (A-40) record the sqlite-v28.sql-unreachable / SCHEMA_VERSION=27 decision and remove or correct the COVERAGE-MATRIX.md citation that treats v28 as active; reconcile the CURRENT-RUN.md line-count drift (it cites 54,687/54,599 - update to whatever the generators report now per baseline.md, regenerating generated docs via their generators, never hand-editing a generated artifact).

Surface SDD-completeness gaps per docs/SPECIFICATION-STANDARD.md section 4: list missing/thin SPEC sections, un-owned concepts, and dangling references across specs/001-011, captured as a dedicated section in docs/DOCS-REAUDIT-2026.md and (where it is a genuine owner decision) as register rows. Do not mark any DRAFT package accepted.

Regenerate any generated doc that your edits affect (build_active_corpus_inventory.py, build_v1_function_contract_ledger.py, build_v1_settings_ledger.py, sync_audit_inventory_v1.py) rather than hand-editing it, then run the gates. Update CURRENT-RUN.md's 'Pending research' and handoff sections in place to reflect what Phase 1 resolved (do not preserve stale status paragraphs; do not rewrite historical dates).
Commit on the feature branch with a conventional message, e.g. 'docs(audit): phase 1 assumption-free corpus re-audit, register A-51.., drift reconciliation'.
acceptance_criteria: docs/DOCS-REAUDIT-2026.md exists with a verdict table covering all five doc clusters, each row carrying a doc+section, the claim, the code reality with a concrete file-path evidence pointer, and a verdict from exactly {true, stale, aspirational-unlabeled, contradicted}; it is linked from docs/README.md.

Every new contradiction is filed in docs/CONTRADICTION-AND-ALIGNMENT-REGISTER.md with sequential IDs starting at A-51 (and any new blocking question at B-34+), and each such row's correction is applied at the owning doc (not only in the register).

A-38 (FLOWS index), A-39 (UIV1 namespace) and A-40 (sqlite-v28 / SCHEMA_VERSION) are each explicitly reconciled with a recorded decision, and the CURRENT-RUN.md line-count drift is corrected to match the current generator output.
An SDD-completeness-gap section enumerates missing SPEC sections / un-owned concepts / dangling references for specs/001-011; no DRAFT package is marked accepted.
No new file is added under reading/ or .zwork/; no generated artifact is hand-edited (any changed generated doc was produced by running its generator).
verification: Run python3 scripts/audit_v1_markdown.py and confirm 0 broken relative links (new doc + edits included).
Run python3 scripts/validate_design_owner_consistency.py and confirm 0 issues (single-owner model preserved).
Run python3 scripts/validate_architecture.py and python3 .specify/scripts/validate_feature_package.py and confirm they pass as in baseline.md.
Run python3 scripts/audit_v1_design_depth.py and confirm the file/line counts it reports now match what CURRENT-RUN.md and COMPLETE-ACTIVE-CORPUS-INVENTORY.md state (drift closed).
grep the register for A-51 and confirm the new rows exist and that each referenced owner doc actually contains the applied correction.
findings: Delivered docs/DOCS-REAUDIT-2026.md (5-cluster doc-claim->code-reality->verdict table + SDD-completeness-gap section for specs/001-011), linked from docs/README.md index. Reconciled the known danglers AT their owners and recorded decisions in the register: A-38 (FLOWS.md flow index now covers F00-F143 with F115-F124/F136-F143 added and the F119/F128 duplicate distinguished as save vs navigation-recovery); A-39 (UIV1-001..158 namespace RETIRED as an active acceptance authority, resolution notes added at V1-UI-ACTION-STATE-LEDGER.md and V1-END-TO-END-FLOW-AND-RACE-CONTRACTS.md, specs/README.md updated, archived catalog kept provenance-only); A-40 (sqlite-v28 confirmed UNWIRED in code - crates/storage-sqlite/src/lib.rs SCHEMA_VERSION=27, last include_str! is v27 - corrected STORAGE.md 'current schema version is 28'->27 plus EVENTS.md/DELEGATION.md/COVERAGE-MATRIX.md to mark v28 as defined-but-not-wired target). Filed ONE new row A-51: WorkbenchPanel.tsx was remediated (TerminalPane now 'unavailable', Review pane 'nothing to review', browser iframe starts empty with no containment) but IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md and rows A-08/A-09/A-10/A-30 still described the old fabricating Terminal/synthetic Diffs/defaulted Browser; corrected the owner and those rows. No B-34 needed (findings reused existing B-22/B-23); RV-13 untouched (reserved Phase 2). Line-count drift closed: CURRENT-RUN.md (54,687/54,599) and IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md (54,473/54,385) updated to the live fixed-point generator output after excluding .agents/ plan files from the five gate/generator scripts (markdown audit 256 files/54,778 lines; design-depth & manifest 259 files/54,865 lines). Regenerated generated docs via their generators (corpus manifest + audit artifacts); reverted the function/settings ledgers which showed only CRLF-vs-LF noise (no function/settings content changed); kept generated .md artifacts in the repo's CRLF convention. All gates green: markdown 0 broken links, design-depth 0 findings, owner-consistency 0 issues (36 assertions), architecture validator passed, feature-package 11/11. No file added under reading/ or .zwork/; no generated artifact hand-edited. ENV: gates must run via the pinned uv env (UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/tmp/uv-python XDG_DATA_HOME=/tmp/uv-data TMPDIR=/tmp uv run --locked python ...); .venv is gitignored; the markdown audit and consistency validator rewrite docs/audit/* to LF on Linux - re-normalize generated .md to CRLF after running them. .agents/*.json plan files are globally gitignored and must be force-added (git add -f).
